features: Admins: the sidebar now shows a count beside every approval queue -- pending registrations, extension requests and token permanence requests -- and it updates as soon as a request is decided.

Admins: admin alerts can now also be sent to a Slack channel, either by email to the channel or through the Liferay Tunnel Slack app. The owner chooses which in System Settings, and every alert type is covered.
Admins: unverified registrations are listed under Registrations in both portals, and only registrations waiting for a decision are counted.
Security update: library updates close published security advisories. Nothing changes in how you use the tunnel.

Security update: the web portal now uses the latest version of its HTTP library, closing published security advisories, and the gateway and client pick up routine library updates. Nothing changes in how you use the tunnel.

More complete gateway reports: when your client moves between gateways during the day, for example while one is restarted and when it moves back, each route is now recorded rather than only the last one. Nothing changes in how you use the tunnel.

Better gateway reports: when your tunnel connects through a regional gateway, the service now records which region you chose and how quickly each one responded, as it already did for direct connections. This feeds the reports used to decide where gateways should run. Nothing changes in how you use the tunnel.

Security update: the gateway and client are now built with Go 1.26.9 and an updated HTTP/2 library, fixing 12 published vulnerabilities in HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 handling, TLS and HTML templating. Nothing changes in how you use the tunnel.
